dogecoin.text: @dogecoin_empire I gave up first class so I could sit with my family. It was only a 4 hour flight and being near my grandson was worth the switch.

@dogecoin_empire It depends, are my seats a special request or were they randomly assigned? Am I traveling alone or with someone else and is it a window seat, I hate window seats. If all those answers are ok, then sure I will switch. No big deal.
